doc.title: Ralph Sutton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995

title: Closing and the evening concert
summary: Rowe previews the concert cast and thanks Sutton.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Okay, well Part II with Ralph Sutton. We’ll get into that. Well I’m looking forward to the concert tonight.
We’re going to have some fun.

You’re going to have some fun. You’ve got a great group coming in with Scott Hamilton and Warren Vache, and of course Bob Haggart who we’re going to talk with, and Kenny Davern, and Bobby Rosengarden. That’s quite a cast. So on behalf of Hamilton College Jazz Archive, I want to thank Ralph Sutton for joining us today. It’s been a real pleasure, and I enjoyed your philosophy on life and music. And thanks for your time.
